meta: Avoid tourist traps and overcharging by asking AI to summarize reviews: a five-star place can still be a trap, because the average hides the complaints.

muc.title: Five stars can still be a trap
muc.text: A place with five-star reviews can still be a tourist trap, because the average score hides the complaints.

muc.title: Group the praise and complaints
muc.text: Paste a few dozen recent reviews into AI and ask what people praise, what they complain about, and which complaint repeats most.

muc.title: Common tricks
muc.text: Ask AI to list common tricks where you're going, like taxis without a meter or menus without prices.

muc.title: Prefer recent reviews
muc.text: Focus on reviews from the last few months, because the place may have changed owners, and AI can mix up old information.

muc.title: A place you plan to visit
muc.text: Copy the 20 latest reviews of a place you plan to visit and ask AI to summarize the complaints that repeat.
